'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Richards DS Kessel: Spice Mines - Administrator's Office''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel: Spice Mines - Administrator's Office|VB7-D-kesselspiceminesadministratorsoffice-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' m007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
